#!/bin/bash
set -e

# 1. convert HF -> gguf f16
python convert_hf_to_gguf.py {{hf_model_dir}} \
  --outfile {{out_gguf}}.f16.gguf --outtype f16

# 2. quantize
./llama-quantize {{out_gguf}}.f16.gguf {{out_gguf}}.{{quant_type}}.gguf {{quant_type}}

echo "done: {{out_gguf}}.{{quant_type}}.gguf"
